subject: Onboarding MAP & legal dependency plan — MedSynergy pilot
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsynergy.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Gavin Lee <gavin.lee@medsynergy.com>, procurement@medsynergy.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding MAP & legal dependency plan — MedSynergy pilot

Hi Lukas / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. To keep momentum on the MedSynergy pilot (MS-2026-PILOT-042) we need a short, executable MAP that shows evaluation milestones + the procurement/legal sequencing (MSA / DPA / order form). Procurement has a hard internal window in December, so clarity on owners and sequencing is the gating item for our launch.

High-level asks from our side:
- MAP with milestone owners and dates (evaluation checkpoints, security evidence, legal review, signatures)
- Explicit sequencing note: can we get the MSA reviewed & signed before the order form is routed to procurement? If not, what are the blockers?
- Any SOC 2 / evidentiary items we should surface now (env access, pen test report, retention policy)
- Point of contact in your billing/procurement team so we can confirm billing/legal info.

Target evaluation window: 4 weeks (target pilot start: early December). We want a short playbook that lets our procurement team map internal approvals to your milestones.

I’ve looped in Gavin (IT) and procurement so they see the ask. Can you return a MAP + sequencing plan by end of day Tue 11/10?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
VP, Product
MedSynergy

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsynergy.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding MAP & legal dependency plan — MedSynergy pilot

Elena — thanks, great to align.

Attached: MedSynergy_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (compact MAP + milestone table). Highlights below so procurement has a reading lane:
- Evaluation: 2026-11-15 -> 2026-12-12 (4-week window). Owner: Gavin Lee (MedSynergy) / Lukas Meyer (Redwood)
- Security evidence (SOC 2 summary + access checklist): deliver by 11/17. Owner: Redwood Security (cc Karhtik for legal visibility)
- Legal review (MSA): 11/12 -> 11/24 (internal Redwood target for redlines and response)
- DPA review: run in parallel with MSA 11/12 -> 11/28 (DPA requires some input from MedSynergy on data categories)
- Order form (pricing & billing): draft prepared; final routing to procurement after MSA redline resolution. Target: sign by 12/03 if redlines cleared.

Key sequencing callout: the order form references contract terms in the MSA (termination/indemnity/usage limits). We recommend MSA agreed in principle before routing the order form to procurement for signature to avoid duplicate redlines. If procurement requires the order form for budget approval earlier, we can provide a placeholder order form marked "pending MSA" but that adds risk of having to re-route signatures.

Risk notes: SOC 2 evidence collection can take additional time if we need full artifacts — we can provide a SOC 2 summary + access to our evidence portal to accelerate. Also, if MedSynergy needs a private deployment (VPC), that adds lead time for KMS/HSM integration.

Next steps: I’ll update the MAP with Karhtik’s legal markups and circulate a clean sequencing view. Scheduling: 30-min sync suggested Wed 11/17 09:00 PT — does that work for your procurement team?

Attachments:
- MedSynergy_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medsynergy.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding MAP & legal dependency plan — MedSynergy pilot

Elena / Lukas — quick legal read here. Thanks for the initial MAP, Lukas — useful. A few practical notes from Redwood Legal so procurement can plan:

- MSA redlines: attached a short markup (redwood_msa_markups.docx). Primary asks from your side we typically see: liability cap, data retention bracket, and export controls. If MedSynergy needs any of those to be adjusted, please flag now; changes late in the flow push the signature date.
- DPA: we can review in parallel (as Lukas suggested) but there are a couple of data-category questions we need from MedSynergy (see inline comments in the markup).
- Order form: to keep momentum, we propose finalizing pricing now and using DocuSign for signature routing once MSA redlines are resolved. That allows procurement to slot the order into your internal approval queue without waiting for physical countersignature.

Quick request: please provide the procurement billing contact (name + remit address + PO process) so finance can confirm invoice routing. Also confirm whether your procurement requires a supplier questionnaire (if yes, we’ll prioritize SOC 2 artifact packaging).

(Quoted for context)

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with our internal expectations. A few confirmations from procurement:

- Procurement contact: Athena Park <procurement@medsynergy.com> (she handles PO generation and Doc signature routing)
- Sequencing we can accept: MSA review window 11/12–11/24, DPA review running parallel 11/12–11/28. Procurement will reserve budget approval contingent on final MSA sign-off.
- If you can provide the final MAP export and a DocuSign order-form link once your legal team resolves core redlines, procurement will queue the PO for the week of 11/29.

We will also need the following evidentiary items by 11/17 to avoid delay: SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram for the pilot, and the list of proposed sub-processors. If any of these are late, our internal approvers will push the pilot start.

Confirming the sync: Wed 11/17 09:00 PT works for Athena and Gavin. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in and attach the latest MAP export + the marked MSA so procurement has both documents ahead of the call.
